note: ⌨️ The keyboard path of every generation3d editor verb a user repeats. A chord here MUST reach an ARG-FREE declared action: `ShellHost`'s keybinding loop fires an arg-free action straight through `onAction`, and opens a staged argument form for anything else — which is slower than the control the chord was meant to replace. `fitGraph` is deliberately absent: it is shell chrome over the node-graph surface, not an app action, and the shell binds `F` to it itself. Driven by `✏️editor/🧪️tests/🔬️unit/🦀️.rs` `the_editor_binds_every_keyboard_verb_the_fixture_names`; this file, not that test, is the statement.

shellChrome.why: Painted by the shell over any node-graph surface, not declared by this app — the app must NOT re-bind it.
